# Sequoia Bridge

> AI-native cross-border advisory from Shanghai to Silicon Valley. Sequoia Bridge helps AI companies prepare for a Pre-IPO path and enter the US market.

Sequoia Bridge is an advisory practice for AI-native companies. Engagements cover IPO readiness, US market entry, partnerships and ecosystem building, events and brand, facilities, power and energy infrastructure, hardware manufacturing, software go-to-market, and regulatory work. Hardware and software clients are advised on different paths. The team is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and works across the US and China.
